MonoBrowser 0.6.1

- Touchpad gestures: swipe two fingers sideways to go back or forward, with an arrow indicator in the theme colours that follows the gesture
- Pin functions (notes, downloads, history, bookmark, private tab, developer tools, compact mode) as toolbar buttons, chosen in Settings → Browsing → Toolbar
- Shorter main menu with Tools and Help submenus; the language option moved to Settings → Browsing
- Delete a space straight from the space switcher (× next to its name)
- Usage statistics: Today, 7 days, 30 days and Total views
- One consistent hover, pressed, selected and focus style across the toolbar, menus, internal pages and overlays
- Pressing Alt no longer reveals the hidden menu bar
- Fixed an invisible menu layer that kept catching clicks after closing the menu with its own button
- Fixed menus that grew and drifted upwards after opening and closing submenus (most visible with the vertical tab sidebar)
- Switching spaces swaps the tabs at once instead of sliding them
- Clicking into a page releases the address bar, so the next click selects the whole address again
- Installing an update reliably closes the previous version

Downloads:
- Windows: `MonoBrowser-Setup-0.6.1.exe`
- Linux: `MonoBrowser-0.6.1-x86_64.AppImage`
